units: Amounts CNY 100 million unless key says CNY, pct, days, shares or multiple. Pct is percent, not fraction.
source_header: 一手财报与行情截至2026-11-06。恢复模型首年100%派息仅为2025-2027规划尾段的时点近似，不是已宣布现金分配；后四年80%为研究假设，非保证、非规划已续期。资产反向敏感性与主恢复模型分开使用，不重复加财务资产价值。
comparability: Issuer says no restatement required. 2025YTD core equals sum of 2025 annual quarterly table Q1+Q2+Q3.

2025Q3.cash_conversion_caveat: No cash-conversion percentage shown for a loss-making period; two negatives do not imply healthy cash conversion.

2026Q3.cash_conversion_caveat: No cash-conversion percentage shown for a loss-making period; two negatives do not imply healthy cash conversion.

2025Q4.cash_conversion_caveat: No cash-conversion percentage shown for a loss-making period; two negatives do not imply healthy cash conversion.

H1.note: Uses absolute denominator for negative prior profit/CFO. A negative change from loss means worsening, not positive growth.

YTD.note: Uses absolute denominator for negative prior profit/CFO. A negative change from loss means worsening, not positive growth.

Q3.note: Uses absolute denominator for negative prior profit/CFO. A negative change from loss means worsening, not positive growth.

valuation.caveat: TTM earnings are near zero due partly to 2025Q4 losses; PE is arithmetic only. Trailing dividend yield is not a promised prospective yield. Negative FCF is not a positive cash earnings yield.

cash_and_quality.cash_caveat: Cash-equivalent subtotal is not legal distributable parent cash. Trading assets involve redemption/valuation risk, not cash equivalents. Other noncurrent financial assets and long-term equity stakes excluded from liquid cash. Subtracting all contract liabilities is an illustrative conservative adjustment, not a liquidation valuation.
cash_and_quality.turnover_caveat: Average year-opening and current balance, 273 days. Long aging raw liquor is not dealer inventory. DIO is an accounting ratio, not a channel-clearance countdown.
cash_and_quality.asset_impairment_note: Large percentage increase is from a tiny base; all YTD asset impairment is only CNY3.61 million and cannot explain the CNY771 million Q3 loss.

scenario_terms.note: Illustrative 2027-2031 earnings/recovery paths, received at each model year end. First year assumes 100% payout reflecting the last year of the 2025-2027 plan; actual declarations/payment dates are not forecast. Later 80% payout is an analyst assumption, not renewed policy. Terminal PE values the whole equity including financial assets; no extra net cash is added. Recovery stress test, not a standalone fair-value conclusion.

asset_reverse_sensitivity.formula: required sustainable core after-tax operating profit = (market cap - separable financial asset scenario value A) / multiple M
asset_reverse_sensitivity.note: A values are pressure-test assumptions, NOT verified excess/distributable net cash. CNY18bn references the CNY18.24884207496bn cash-equivalents plus trading assets less named debt upper subtotal, before a full operating-reserve allowance. Required profit excludes income from separated financial assets. Do not add A to a valuation of unadjusted total net profit; do not add inventory. This is the current price's implied earnings requirement, not proof of cheapness or an addition to the recovery model.
asset_reverse_sensitivity.precision: Decimal, 40 significant digits. Each cell retains the exact numerator and denominator as well as the decimal quotient; no binary float arithmetic.
